text:
Ivy: Heads-up: planning a micro-canary for comet-13b-v2 in eu-west-1 at 09:45 CET. Ladder: 1% -> 4% -> 8%. Gates: p99 < 1100ms, 5m errors < 0.4%, hallucination delta < 1.5%. If any gate trips, rollback and pin comet-13b-v1.
Marco: Copy. I'll attach the preflight and enable the canary-smoke set. Adding fallback: [comet-13b-v2, comet-13b-v1, zephyr-lite].
Ben: Note: last run showed a p99 bump under multi-turn chat loads. Recommend enabling prefix-cache on chat-route and lowering batch size from 16 -> 8 for the canary.
deploybot: /deploy start --catalog comet-13b-v2 --region eu-west-1 --ladder 1,4,8 --checks telemetry,quality -> scheduled for 2026-03-23T08:45:00Z
Ivy: Cache and batch config updated in canary config. Also pushed a short release-note draft to docs.
sre-bot: alert rule created: catalog.canary.p99.eu-west-1 > 1100ms for 5m -> channel: #incidents
deploybot: Stage 1 complete: 1% -> OK. snapshot: p99=980ms, errors=0.10%, hallucination=0.2%
deploybot: Stage 2 complete: 4% -> warning on p99. snapshot: p99=1080ms, errors=0.32%, hallucination=0.6%
Ben: p99 near limit but within gate. Hold before 8% to review slow traces.
Marco: pulled traces; most slow calls are long multi-turn histories. Could try trimming prefix length for chat-route temporarily.
Ivy: trimming prefix by 256 tokens for canary routes and retrying final step.
deploybot: Stage 3 complete: 8% -> gate breach on errors. snapshot: p99=1230ms, errors=0.55%, hallucination=1.9%
Ivy: We're over errors and hallucination. Initiating rollback to comet-13b-v1 and applying pin.
deploybot: rollback initiated -> routing back to comet-13b-v1; catalog.pin=comet-13b-v1
deploybot: rollback complete. post-rollback snapshot: p99=990ms, errors=0.11%, hallucination=0.0%
Marco: Saving artifacts s3://canary-artifacts/comet13b-v2/1750050000/. Scheduling triage with infra and research tomorrow 11:00 CET.
Ben: Proposed next steps in the doc: longer evals (20k prompts), smaller final step (6%), and test truncated-history mode.
Ivy: Agreed. I'll update rollout doc and ping support/product for visibility. Closing thread.
